svg.title: Selected design for Core v0 build packaging and deployment pipeline
svg.desc: Controlled source feeds Maven Wrapper for the Server JAR, npm and Vite for React assets, and dotnet for WPF Workspace and Worker binaries. Outputs pass through versioning dependency inventory SBOM checksums signing and release review before a release bundle is assembled. The bundle deploys separately to Linux Server Windows Client and Windows Worker targets. Every stage is selected design with implementation not run.
